sources.title: Fuel prices
sources.note: General retail prices announced each week. Prices under the subsidy schemes (BUDI 95 and SKPS petrol, BUDI Diesel) are separate columns in the dataset and are not shown here.

sources.title: US dollar in ringgit
sources.note: Bank Negara Malaysia's end-of-day reference rate, set at 5 pm on each working day: the middle of its buying and selling rates. Higher means a weaker ringgit.

sources.title: Consumer price inflation
sources.note: Change in the consumer price index, all goods and services, compared with the same month a year earlier.

sources.title: Unemployment rate
sources.note: Unemployed people as a share of the labour force, from the quarterly Labour Force Survey.

sources.title: Economic output (GDP)
sources.note: Gross domestic product at constant 2015 prices. State figures come from the state-level dataset, the Malaysia comparison from the national one.
